words.def: a clear limit you set to protect your time or energy
words.ex: She set a {boundary}: no work calls after seven in the evening.

words.def: to fail to give enough attention or care to something
words.ex: When he is busy, he tends to {neglect} his own health.

words.def: helping you feel fresh and full of energy again
words.ex: A long walk in nature can be deeply {restorative}.

words.def: a method someone uses to manage stress or difficult emotions
words.ex: Going for a run is her main {coping strategy} when work gets overwhelming.

words.def: to make yourself exhausted by doing too much for a long time
words.ex: If you never take breaks, you'll {wear yourself out} before the end of the year.

words.def: done on purpose, with a clear aim
words.ex: She {intentionally} sets aside time each week to do something just for herself.

words.def: to stop thinking about problems and feel calmer
words.ex: A short run helps him {clear his head} after a long meeting.

words.def: able to continue for a long time without causing problems
words.ex: Small daily habits are more {sustainable} than big changes.
